dogecoin.text: Why did #Dogecoin just tank like that?!

If you invested $1,000 into #Dogecoin the day after the Super Bowl @$.05 (20k shares) and sold at its high of $.71 you would’ve made $13,200 and if you invested another $1,000 in #AMC at the same time @ $6.18 (162 shares) and sold @ high of $32.04 you would’ve made $3,672
